entries.what: The page opens, live, while the blind run is under way. It leads with what went wrong during the run and what was done, then shows each family's progress as totals only: no statement's outcome appears until the run has ended, and nobody knows which statements are true, planted or decoys until the key is opened.
The Claude Opus 5.5 family finished batches b4, b6 and b7. The Claude Opus 5.5 family started batches b8 and b9.
The Claude Opus 5.5 family finished batches b8 and b9, its last. The run has ended.
